era: Seventh-generation and remastered open-world crime action
summary: United Front Games and Square Enix's Hong Kong open-world action game, originally born from the canceled True Crime: Hong Kong but released as a separate IP.

entries.title: Sleeping Dogs
entries.definitive_edition: Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the Definitive Edition on PC rather than emulating PS3/Xbox 360.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Definitive Edition at highest stable settings

primary.why: Sleeping Dogs released for Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360 in 2012. Definitive Edition followed for Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and later macOS, bundling the released DLC and improving audio-visual quality and gameplay. Windows Definitive Edition is the fidelity and completeness route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition on Windows at the highest stable settings; use PS4/Xbox One as strong console alternatives or macOS if needed.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release and 2014 Definitive Edition with DLC and audio-visual/gameplay improvements.

entries.remaster_caveats: Triad Wars was a canceled spin-off, not a released game entry. Definitive Edition is the recommended route for DLC completeness and improved presentation.
